snippet.title: Version "Luna II" "An Elegy for Faded Moonlight" Trailer | Genshin Impact #GenshinLunaII
snippet.description:
Version "Song of the Welkin Moon: Reprise" "An Elegy for Faded Moonlight" Trailer | Genshin Impact
Wayfarer traversing an ocean of sand, why do you linger beneath the moonlight?
Weary beast, dragging your worn-out limbs, why do you roar to the moonless night sky?
Secrets cannot stay buried forever. The moonlight will shine through the tide of history and cast light upon every solitary shadow.

VA:
